secondarysystem/sec-trivia/text:
Sega CD/Mega CD is an add-on for the Sega Genesis/Mega Drive video game console.
First released in Japan in December 1991 and discontinued in 1996.
About 6 million units were sold.
Its library has 207 games.
It followed the Sega Genesis and was succeeded by the Sega Saturn.
Processors include the Motorola 68000.
